description: Flinging six times up through a 60-exchange transcript (markdown replies, tool cards) and six times back down
placeholder_note: PLACEHOLDER, not measured: no device was available when this was written. The baselines are 60 Hz frame budgets, not measurements, so do not gate against them. bench/app/run_frame_bench.sh sees this flag and writes measured medians instead (keeping margins, min_samples, optional and the note); review and commit those with the perf-rebaseline label.
note: Reference phone class (R12 §3.10 device matrix): Adreno <= 650, Impeller on the GLES path. Physical device, median of 5 launches; relative margin +15% with absolute caps of two frames (p90) and four frames (p99) at 60 Hz (R12 §3.8). min_frames is set to 90% of the measured frame count by the first rebaseline.
